summary: Phase 58 full backend + frontend verification. Story Analytics endpoints (/answer, /insights, /public-insights) and AI router extraction (/api/ai/*) all PASS — 13/13 pytest cases green. Frontend smoke for Story viewer (insights button + modal + counters owner-mode + close), ChatPage refactor (list, search, new-chat modal, chat detail with textarea + audio playback rendering), and Camera interactive panel (4 tabs, CTA no longer occluded by MobileBottomNav) all pass. Phase 57 HIGH UX issue (panel CTA at y=788-828 behind nav) is FIXED — measured panel CTA at y=724-764 vs MobileBottomNav at y=776-832 (12px gap).

issues: Console reports 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings on /feed (React duplicate keys in list — likely story rings or feed items rendered from non-unique ids). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up to avoid future render bugs.

Multiple 'empty string passed to src attribute' warnings — Image components are receiving '' for src (probably story.media_url='' for text-type stories, or avatar fallback). Should guard with conditional render or placeholder.

action_items: (Minor) Fix duplicate React key warnings in feed story list / interest-based posts — happens on /feed render.
(Minor) Guard against empty-string media_url for text-only stories or missing avatars.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/stories.py answer endpoint correctly uses $pull then $push to dedupe per-user (lines 644-656). However, this is two non-atomic operations; in extremely rare concurrent calls from the same user, both could insert. Acceptable for current scale; consider $set on a map keyed by user_id long-term.
routers/stories.py insights endpoint sorts answers DESC by created_at and hydrates avatars in a single $in query (good). reactions_by_emoji aggregates client-side (fine for current volume).
routers/stories.py public-insights `voted_idx` logic is dead code (computed then discarded; only `has_voted` is exposed). Minor cleanup — remove the unused branching.
routers/ai.py extraction is clean — prefix='/ai', tags set, BRUNO_SYSTEM_MESSAGE + ai_chat_sessions migrated. All 4 endpoints (history, chat, recommend, generate-card) return 200 in live tests.
server.py reduced ~488 lines as expected; ai_router included via api_router.include_router(ai_router) at line 3103.

BrunoStoryViewer.jsx correctly fetches public-insights on story change and conditionally renders the insights button when story has poll, has answers, or viewer is owner (line 475). Pauses timer on open (setPaused(true)) and resumes on close — verified live.
StoryInsightsModal.jsx switches endpoint based on isOwner. Counters block (data-testid='story-insights-counters') only renders for owners — verified live with viewer-as-owner showing 3-column grid.
ChatPage.jsx is now 1161 lines (target was -470 from 1672 — actually 511 lines removed). Extracted components live in /components/chat/*. No console errors at /chat boot.
Iteration 57 HIGH UX issue: camera interactive panel CTA bottom-overlap with MobileBottomNav — VERIFIED FIXED. On 390x844, panel CTA renders y=724-764, MobileBottomNav y=776-832 → 12px clearance.
seed_data_creation: Created a text-only story via POST /api/stories/ during testing to allow viewer/insights smoke.
